mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id,COALESCE(c.data_generation,1) AS data_generation,COALESCE(c.checkpoint_version,0) AS checkpoint_version, COALESCE(c.manifest_version,0) AS manifest_version,t.repair_epoch,COALESCE(c.manifest_sealed,FALSE) AS manifest_sealed, COALESCE(c.segment_count,0) AS segment_count,COALESCE(c.manifest_row_count,0) AS manifest_row_count,c.manifest_digest, c.configuration_hash,t.total_count,t.repair_attempt, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('sequence',s.sequence,'previousCursor',s.previous_cursor_json,'lastCursor',s.last_cursor_json, 'rowCount',s.row_count,'configurationHash',s.configuration_hash,'formatVersion',s.format_version,'contentChecksum',s.content_checksum, 'selectionVersion',s.selection_version,'state',s.state,'selectedBlock',IF(b.block_id IS NULL,NULL,JSON_OBJECT( 'blockId',b.block_id,'header',JSON_OBJECT('version',b.format_version,'configHash',b.configuration_hash,'generation',b.data_generation, 'sequence',b.sequence,'previousCursor',b.previous_cursor_json,'lastCursor',b.last_cursor_json,'rowCount',b.row_count), 'storageRef',CAST(b.storage_ref AS JSON),'byteSize',b.byte_size,'checksum',b.checksum)))) FROM export_data_segments s LEFT JOIN export_data_blocks b ON b.block_id=s.active_block_id AND b.task_id=s.task_id AND b.data_generation=s.data_generation AND b.sequence=s.sequence WHERE s.task_id=t.task_id AND s.data_generation=c.data_generation) AS segments_json FROM export_tasks t LEFT JOIN export_checkpoints c ON c.task_id=t.task_id WHERE t.task_id=#{value}
